question: Should OpenClaw add bundled dashboard log-tail and command-output widgets now, and what redaction, permission, retention, export, and command-binding boundaries must they follow?
rationale: The feature exposes sensitive runtime logs and command output in a new dashboard surface and depends on unmerged dashboard/binding APIs, so code inspection cannot choose the product and security boundary for maintainers.

options.title: Stage After Substrate And Security Review
options.body: Keep the issue open until Wave 1 dashboard APIs land or are rejected, then implement read-only widgets with explicit redaction, scopes, retention, and export rules.

options.title: Narrow To Existing Read Data
options.body: Allow only logs.tail and already-recorded command-output display first, with no new command execution or stream binding until #101150 is resolved.

options.title: Defer Bundled Builtins
options.body: Leave this as roadmap work or an external/plugin experiment until dashboard widget APIs and security boundaries stabilize.

recommendation.title: Stage After Substrate And Security Review
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open until Wave 1 dashboard APIs land or are rejected, then implement read-only widgets with explicit redaction, scopes, retention, and export rules.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main ownership signal is the merged plugin-tab seam and adjacent Control UI work from PR #99930.
